descriptions.zh:
- **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解Tablestore产品的计费说明和价格。更多信息，请参见[计费概览](~~27291~~)。**
- 单个阿里云账户最多可以创建10个智能体存储，且在同一地域中智能体存储名称必须唯一。
descriptions.en:
- **Before you use this operation, make sure that you fully understand the billing of Tablestore. For more information, see [Billing overview](~~27291~~).**
- You can create up to 10 agent storages for a single Alibaba Cloud account. Agent storage names must be unique within the same region.
